title: Catalytic hydrothermal liquefaction of spent coffee grounds: optimization of process parameters for production of biocrude oil through combined RSM and ANN based methodology
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,1321-1338
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01549A, Paper
Deepak Bhushan, Philip E. Boahene, Ajay K. Dalai, Prasenjit Mondal
This study investigates the catalytic HTL of spent coffee grounds for enhanced biocrude production. Process parameters were optimized using response surface methodology (RSM) and artificial neural networks (ANN).
